item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 28, 2026
item.description: Israel kills three Palestinians in Gaza attacks. Israeli attacks have killed at least three Palestinians in the Gaza Strip, including two people targeted by a drone in the north of the enclave. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing: June 20, 2026
item.description: Parents and two daughters killed in Israeli strike in Gaza.. Israel has repeatedly violated the October ceasefire brokered by the US. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.
